news.headline: Zscaler (ZS) Stock Price Jumps As Q1 Results Expose ARR Slowdown
news.summary: Zscaler just dropped its Q1 2027 scorecard and the stock answered instantly. The share price jumped 17.7% in a single session to about US$229, after closing near US$195 the previous day. That is a big move for any cybersecurity player. The headline is simple. Revenue reached US$949.3 million for the quarter and the business still reported a loss, with basic earnings per share in negative territory

news.headline: Palo Alto Has “a Really Good Chance of Being a Trillion Dollar Business,” Says Chamath. Here’s What It Takes
news.summary: Key TakeawaysChamath Palihapitiya says Palo Alto Networks could become a trillion-dollar business within a decade, more than triple its market value. Analysts see revenue growth around 15% a year after this fiscal year, and the stock trades at 79x forward earnings, against a five-year average of 57x.
